q: Normal numbers (every block of digits appears with the correct frequency) are related to ergodic theory by the fact that x ∈ [0,1] is normal in base b iff:
opts: Its continued fraction expansion is bounded
The orbit of x under the ×b map (x ↦ bx mod 1) is equidistributed with respect to Lebesgue measure
The ×b map is a contraction at x
exp: Normality in base b ↔ equidistribution of the orbit under T_b(x) = bx (mod 1) w.r.t. Lebesgue measure. By Birkhoff's theorem and ergodicity of T_b, Lebesgue-a.e. x is normal in base b (Borel's theorem).
